svg.title: A real run: Claude Haiku 4.5 with Vestigium on the bundled sample (a 10-page GAO report)
svg.desc: A real run: Claude Haiku 4.5 with Vestigium on the bundled sample (a 10-page GAO report). What staffing gap did GAO report for FEMA in May 2023, and what workforce reduction did it report in September 2025? search(doc="gao-26-107790", query="FEMA staffing gap May 2023") search(doc="gao-26-107790", query="FEMA workforce reduction September 2025") Staffing gap in May 2023: GAO reported in May 2023 that FEMA had an overall staffing gap of about 35 percent (6,200 staff) between the number of disaster employees on board and the agency's staffing goal across different positions in fiscal year 2022. (p. 6) Workforce reduction in September 2025: GAO reported in September 2025 that FEMA experienced workforce reductions of about 10 percent (about 2,450 staff) from January 1 through June 1, 2025, amid efforts from the Executive Branch to reduce the size of the federal workforce. (p. 7) Claude Haiku 4.5 · 8 s · $0.016
